description: This Java source file defines the ResolutionHelper class, which provides methods for creating dependency maps among batch requests and resolving dependencies based on parent responses. It includes nested classes, dependency tree building, and request resolution logic.

classes.name: ResolutionHelper
classes.description: Provides methods for dependency mapping and resolution among batch requests, including building request trees and resolving dependencies based on parent responses.

classes.name: ResolutionHelper.BatchRequestNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the request dependency tree, holding a BatchRequest and its child nodes.

methods.name: buildNodesTree
methods.description: Builds a dependency tree of BatchRequestNodes from a list of BatchRequests based on their references.

methods.name: addDependingRequest
methods.description: Recursively adds a BatchRequest as a child to its parent node in the dependency tree based on request references.

methods.name: resolveRequest
methods.description: Resolves dependencies in a BatchRequest by updating its body and URL based on the parent BatchResponse.

methods.name: resolveDependentVariables
methods.description: Resolves variables within JSON elements that depend on parent response data.

methods.name: processJsonObject
methods.description: Processes a JSON object, resolving dependencies within its entries.

methods.name: processJsonArray
methods.description: Processes a JSON array, resolving dependencies within its elements.

methods.name: processJsonPrimitive
methods.description: Processes a JSON primitive, resolving special placeholders like $[ARRAYDATE] and JSONPath expressions.
